decisions.reason: As a core extension of the firm's established coolant-management portfolio that remained promoted through 2024, the pressure booster system is very likely to be retained.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's engineering-led process-media offering and ongoing demand for efficient, sustainable production makes withdrawal unlikely.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's established material-flow business and its continued website presence suggests it has earned a place in the portfolio.
The hinged belt chip conveyor complements the firm's broad automation and chip-handling range, so management would likely keep it unless sales were clearly disappointing.
